Game Overview

In Pinkii 2, the core idea is straightforward: leap into Pinkii 2, a vibrant 2D platformer, where you'll collect yellow flowers, evading crafty foes and soaring monsters. Challenge yourself across eight increasingly difficult levels, using smooth double jumps and quick reflexes to reach your goal—the elusive pink flag. Can you conquer this colorful adventure?
